name: Acceptable Hyena Sample
summary: An acceptable hyena sample is data gathered with Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle’s field testing kit in Tanaris. It is one part of his survey of the desert’s wildlife.

sections.title: Desert Samples
sections.body: In Tanaris, the field testing kit can yield an acceptable hyena sample from an untested one. Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle needs eight hyena samples, alongside samples from basilisks and scorpions, for his survey. The kit’s power source gives you two hours to gather the data before it is lost.

faq.q: What is an acceptable hyena sample?
faq.answer: An acceptable hyena sample is data gathered from an untested hyena sample with Bilgewhizzle’s field testing kit.
Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan needs eight acceptable hyena samples for his Tanaris field survey.

faq.q: How many hyena samples does Bilgewhizzle need?
faq.answer: Bilgewhizzle needs eight acceptable hyena samples, as well as eight each from basilisks and scorpions.

faq.q: Why is there a time limit?
faq.answer: The field testing kit’s power source gives you two hours to collect the data. If it runs out, the data inside is lost.
